name: Ziaul Hoque Polash
description: Widely famous for playing 'Kabila' in Bachelor Point, Polash is a regular collaborator with Ome and also a director himself.
directorMemory: Polash is like family. His dedication to character work, particularly with Kabila, brought a completely new flavor to Bangladeshi comedy.

name: Mishu Sabbir
description: Known for his role as 'Shuvo' in Bachelor Point, Mishu's natural comedic timing and delivery have made him a staple in Ome's ensemble.
directorMemory: Mishu understands the rhythm of my writing perfectly. He knows exactly when to pause and when to deliver the punchline.

name: Marzuk Russell
description: Playing the iconic 'Pasha Bhai', Marzuk Russell is a poet and actor whose unique persona became one of the biggest attractions of Ome's works.
directorMemory: Marzuk Bhai brings an eccentricity to the set that you can't write into a script. Pasha Bhai was a cultural phenomenon because of him.

name: Chashi Alam
description: Known as 'Habu Bhai', Chashi Alam's expressions and comedic innocence won the hearts of millions of viewers.
directorMemory: Chashi Bhai's facial expressions alone can carry a scene. The audience loves him because his innocence is absolutely genuine.

name: Afran Nisho
description: A superstar of Bangladeshi television and cinema, Nisho's performance in 'Sorry Sir' is considered one of his most emotionally impactful roles.
directorMemory: Nisho Bhai dives deep into the psychology of the character. When we did Sorry Sir, he completely transformed into that broken student.

name: Tanjin Tisha
description: Tanjin Tisha has collaborated with Ome on several emotional and romantic dramas, bringing depth to her characters.
directorMemory: Tisha has this ability to convey profound sadness with just her eyes. She grounds the emotional weight of my stories.

name: Ziaul Faruq Apurba
description: The king of romance in Bangladeshi TV, Apurba has worked with Ome on several hit romantic dramas.
directorMemory: Apurba Bhai is a true professional. He understands the romantic genre better than anyone and always delivers what the audience wants.

name: Tariq Anam Khan
description: A legendary actor who brought incredible gravitas and weight to Ome's tragedy web film 'Oshomoy'.
directorMemory: Working with a legend like Tariq Sir on Oshomoy was a masterclass. His screen presence anchored the entire film.
